lead.event: MSCI's proposed Indonesia reclassification and official responses
lead.headline: MSCI proposes standalone status for Indonesia, with a decision due by 30 June 2027
lead.blurb: The proposal would remove Indonesian stocks from MSCI’s main global indexes, including the MSCI Emerging Markets Index, though MSCI could calculate a separate Indonesia index. MSCI cited concerns over ownership transparency, alleged coordinated trading, weak enforcement and stock investability, and opened consultation through 30 April 2027. Former Deputy Foreign Minister Dino Patti Djalal urged a constructive response, stronger OJK supervision and a task force to improve transparency and governance, while House Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad said the market has strong fundamentals and participants could determine Indonesia’s rating. MSCI’s final decision is due by 30 June 2027.

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBRI plans second-phase share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The planned period runs from 22 October 2026 to 21 January 2027. BRI plans to use the shares for an employee share ownership program and/or members of its board of directors and board of commissioners, subject to General Meeting of Shareholders approval. Pro forma consolidated capital adequacy ratio and return on equity as of 30 June 2026 were 21.42% and 18.80%.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Cipta Perdana Lancar director's share purchase and planned corporate actions
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PART prepares Rp200 billion rights issue as president director buys 1,883,400 shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Cipta Perdana Lancar is also preparing a buyback of up to 10% of paid-up capital, with rights proceeds mainly for working capital. Hamim’s purchase raised his direct holding to 9.61%. An EGM will seek approval for both actions, and the company targets the offering after approval and an OJK effective statement.

earnings_guidance.headline: BUKA reports Rp881.06 billion net loss through September
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bukalapak recorded a Rp2.04 trillion investment value loss, reversing a Rp2.32 trillion gain a year earlier, and an operating loss of Rp1.14 trillion. Net revenue rose 19.34% to Rp5.64 trillion.

earnings_guidance.headline: AKRA reports Rp2.21 trillion net profit through Q3 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: AKR Corporindo's revenue rose 43.6% over the nine-month period.

earnings_guidance.headline: DEWA reports Q3 2026 net profit of Rp513.08 billion, up 114.55%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Darma Henwa's revenue rose 9.71% year on year to Rp5.10 trillion, all from mining services, while cost of revenue increased 2.26% to Rp4.06 trillion. Basic earnings per share climbed to Rp13.10 from Rp6.34.

earnings_guidance.event: Bakrie Sumatera Plantations' September 2026 financial results
earnings_guidance.headline: UNSP reports Rp43.47 billion net loss for first nine months of 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: The loss narrowed 31.5% year on year, while sales rose 18.81% to Rp2.21 trillion. Equity swung to Rp2.77 trillion from negative Rp5.27 trillion at end-2025, and liabilities fell to Rp4.71 trillion from Rp8.75 trillion.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX-listed banks' compliance with the minimum free-float requirement
market_structure_policy.headline: 26 IDX-listed banks remain below 15% free-float requirement
market_structure_policy.blurb: Ten must reach 12.5% and two must reach 15% by 31 March 2027, while 14 have until 31 March 2029. Bank Syariah Indonesia (BRIS) plans a rights issue of up to 6.8 billion Series B shares, with maximum dilution of 12.85%, for shareholder approval on 6 November; OJK says delisting is among the options for noncompliant banks.
